# mushroomdb

> mushroomdb is a graph database for any app that needs one. Embedded in your
> process, or run as a server. It has Cypher queries, transactions,
> constraints and indexes, time travel, and self-maintaining derived edges,
> plus a memory layer for AI agents.

Embedded for Rust, Python and TypeScript; `mushroomdb serve` adds HTTP and Bolt.

## Capabilities

- Cypher: an openCypher subset with a published conformance rate
- Transactions: atomic multi-statement writes over HTTP and Bolt
- Constraints and indexes: unique constraints, property indexes, full text
- Time travel: query or open the graph at a past commit
- Derived edges: declare a rule once; writes add and retract matching edges
- Agent memory: `remember`/`recall`, hybrid search, an MCP server

## Install

```sh
cargo add mushroomdb            # Rust, embedded
cargo install mushroomdb-cli    # CLI and server (mushroomdb serve)
pip install mushroomdb          # Python
npm install mushroomdb-client   # TypeScript client
npx mushroomdb install          # assistant plugin and MCP entry
```

Docker and configuration: [Get started](docs/site/get-started.md).
